claim_boundary: These are stellar-model and climate-boundary conditional incident-flux histories. They are not observations of past climate, probabilities of surface liquid water, habitability, atmospheres, biology or life. The three prescriptions share the Kopparapu 1D framework and do not substitute for an independent 3D GCM ensemble.
label: MODEL-INFERRED

support_contract.age_precision: max relative side <= 0.75 and 68% interval <= 6.0 Gyr
support_contract.required: finite central values and asymmetric uncertainties for age, mass, metallicity, log luminosity and semimajor axis
support_contract.stellar_model: at least half of posterior draws must remain inside the MIST phase-0 interpolation grid

title: MIST-anchored time-dependent habitable-zone inference
